svg.text: Marketing agents got a prompt library.
That is why they fail. So I built the harness.
same loop · same gates · same enforcement — a different domain
is the context layer: audiences, claims, gates, metrics — schema-validated so hooks can refuse, not suggest.
Every check says which kind of green it is:
First thing the fuzzer caught: a 3-day reminder timer that would have sent on a Friday, outside the send window. Before anyone was emailed.
